_readme: Keys that exist in eng.json and are knowingly NOT yet translated. Enrolling a key here is how a new English string lands without turning the locale-parity gate red — an explicit, reviewable admission of debt instead of silent drift. This file IS the work order for the 21-language translation pass: every key below is a string a translator has to do. When a key is translated into every locale, DELETE it from here — the parity test fails on a stale entry, so the list can only shrink. Never add a key here to silence a gate you could satisfy by wiring an existing key instead.
_minted: 2026-09-03 — the i18n sweep that keyed the settings, player, onboarding, install, redeem and profile screens. 2026-09-07 — the schools/teach/org sweep: 1,281 keys across the teacher, school-leader and tutor surfaces. About half of those reached the 21 languages the 2026-09-02 branch covered, by harvest, for free. The rest — and the whole of kan/mar/tel, which that branch never had — await a run of `pnpm i18n:fill`. That run could NOT be done on 2026-09-07: no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR on this box is logged in for headless use, so every `claude -p` exited 1. Re-run it from a logged-in box and this list shrinks on its own.
